title: H353 stub: Cross-Market Alpha — 17 A-share microstructural signals on US S&P 500
rationale: Du et al. (2026) use double-selection LASSO to identify 17 price-volume and microstructural signals from Chinese A-share markets that transfer to US S&P 500 (2002-2022), surviving control for 151 established fundamental factors. This is a direct H198 signal extension candidate: the H198 universe is 30 S&P 500 large-caps, exactly the paper's target market. The signals are short-term (intraday/daily frequency) but could serve as monthly momentum signal components. Key signals mentioned: rank of delayed price-gap correlation, overnight gap return, volume-intraday correlation, and 14 others. High relevance for extending H198 signal set beyond the 6-1m momentum baseline.
